# Run ledger — P17.2 (broader FR / CSS / forensics)

- spec: docs/tickets/P17.2__broader-fr-css-forensics.md
- base commit: c79fdbd (P17.1 tip)
- branch: devin/p17-2-broader-fr-css-forensics

## Approach
Mirror P17.1 exactly: populate the Stage-5 span as **test-only instance graphs**
over the committed generated Pydantic model + committed vocab, with **no schema
change** (a required change = a red conformance test = a recorded Phase-1 defect,
owned by P01.1). New file: `tests/ontology/generalization/test_stage5_forensics.py`.
Plus traceability.md + risk_register.md (Phase 17 / P17.2). No LinkML/generated edits.

Key model facts:
- Capability(capability=slug, scope). Deployment(product/vendor optional -> None;
  technology[list]; actually_provides_capability[list]; authorization_state:
  AuthorizationState; deploying_organization). No PhysicalAsset needed.
- FR "searches_against reference db" (§11.10 SIG-ONTO-031) realized in closed
  catalog as IntegrationEdge federates_search_to (query moves, corpus stays).
- authorizes edge (EdgeType.authorizes, "no data moves") -> StructuralEdge.
- Native validity interval encoded EDTF: use db.edtf.parse_edtf -> EdtfInterval
  (NOT EdtfDate) with distinct bounds; derive_envelope lower<upper => not a point.
- ConfiguredBaseModel: extra=forbid, use_enum_values=True (compare enum .value).
- Person MUST NOT be minted (§11.3/§43.4) — assert zero Person nodes.

Capability slugs (exist): search.face.{own,state,national,commercial,partner},
locate.handset.rf, extract.device.{logical,physical}, extract.cloud.account.
Technology slugs (exist): face-identification-1ton (domain biometric-id),
cell-site-simulator-general (domain comms-intercept),
extraction-logical/physical, cloud-account-extraction (domain device-forensics).
